searchText: Howdy folks. I was finally convinced to bite the bullet and create an acct on yet another chat app, since the Telegram bridge apparently only works on the "<#598292067260825641>" server. Who knew? Anyway, I'm Steven, I work for PegaSys as a researcher for stateless on Besu (Eth1) and an engineer on Teku (Eth2). hi - I've come to join the fun - who doesn't love another chat app 😅 I'm Madeline, working for PegaSys and about to start working on the Teku docs. I'm Adrian and also work for PegaSys on Teku. The PegaSys team have been lurking over on the other side of the Telegram bridge for a while and missing half the fun. We've recently ramped up the number of people focussing on Teku and are going to try to do better at looking up from our work to say hi in public more. Hi all - I'm Paul, also at Pegasys. I’m another one of the PegaSys team now focusing on the ConsenSys Eth2 client Teku. Specifically, my area of interest is interoperability between Teku and all the other wonderful Eth2 clients ...meaning you’ll probably be seeing me in the testnets channel 😄 Yo, PegaSys is in da house.
